description: Source code for the FFPage class in Playwright's Firefox backend, managing page interactions, events, and communication with the browser protocol.

classes.name: FFPage
classes.description: Represents a Firefox page in Playwright, handling browser protocol events, page actions, and interactions.

methods.name: _reportAsNew
methods.description: Reports the page as new, handling errors and ensuring it's only reported once.

methods.name: _onWebSocketCreated
methods.description: Handles WebSocket creation events, updating frame manager accordingly.

methods.name: _onWebSocketClosed
methods.description: Handles WebSocket closure events, updating frame manager and error states.

methods.name: _onExecutionContextCreated
methods.description: Handles creation of new JavaScript execution contexts.

methods.name: _onExecutionContextDestroyed
methods.description: Handles destruction of JavaScript execution contexts.

methods.name: _onExecutionContextsCleared
methods.description: Handles clearing of all execution contexts.

methods.name: _removeContextsForFrame
methods.description: Removes execution contexts associated with a specific frame.

methods.name: _onLinkClicked
methods.description: Handles link click phases to manage navigation requests.

methods.name: _onNavigationCommitted
methods.description: Handles navigation commit events, including worker cleanup.

methods.name: _onEventFired
methods.description: Handles generic page lifecycle events like load and DOMContentLoaded.

methods.name: _onConsole
methods.description: Handles console messages from the page.

methods.name: didClose
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the page is closed.

methods.name: navigateFrame
methods.description: Navigates a specific frame to a URL.

methods.name: updateExtraHTTPHeaders
methods.description: Updates HTTP headers for network requests.

methods.name: bringToFront
methods.description: Brings the page to the front.

methods.name: addInitScript
methods.description: Adds an initialization script to the page.

methods.name: takeScreenshot
methods.description: Takes a screenshot of the page.

methods.name: getContentFrame
methods.description: Gets the content frame of an element.

methods.name: getOwnerFrame
methods.description: Gets the owner frame of an element.

methods.name: getBoundingBox
methods.description: Calculates the bounding box of an element.

methods.name: scrollRectIntoViewIfNeeded
methods.description: Scrolls a rect into view if needed.

methods.name: rafCountForStablePosition
methods.description: Returns the RAF count for stable position.

methods.name: getContentQuads
methods.description: Gets content quads of an element.

methods.name: setInputFilePaths
methods.description: Sets file input paths for a file input element.

methods.name: adoptElementHandle
methods.description: Adopts an element handle into another context.

methods.name: resetForReuse
methods.description: Resets page state for reuse, e.g., moving mouse position.

methods.name: getFrameElement
methods.description: Gets the DOM element for a frame.

methods.name: shouldToggleStyleSheetToSyncAnimations
methods.description: Indicates if style sheet toggling is needed for animation sync.

methods.name: setDockTile
methods.description: Sets the dock tile image (not implemented).
